# Wave 1 CI audit

Repository: `boop-bip80/LINUX-LOGIC-PRO`  
Audited publication commit: `3ecbd5bbb5e173ab74c2f2db236744b2fc81de69`  
Tested source candidate: `00b172d8b1363c2f21deb3cbd0fb29a908ea86fc`  
Scope: read-only workflow and failed-job diagnosis; no Git writes or comments.

## Active failed CI: Darling source package

The failure is confirmed in [Darling CI run 42323661071](https://github.com/boop-bip80/LINUX-LOGIC-PRO/actions/runs/42323661071), [build-dsc job 128255470003](https://github.com/boop-bip80/LINUX-LOGIC-PRO/actions/runs/42323661071/job/128255470003), step **Build DSCs**.

The source artifact job succeeded. The build-deb job remained in progress at the final observation; its result was not yet established.

### Exact error

```text
2026-11-07T01:40:53.8249845Z dpkg-buildpackage: info: source version 0.1.20261107~resolute
2026-11-07T01:40:53.9031140Z  dpkg-source --before-build .
2026-11-07T01:40:54.0535670Z  debian/rules clean
2026-11-07T01:40:54.0565642Z dh clean --builddirectory=debbuild
2026-11-07T01:40:57.4074115Z  dpkg-source -b .
2026-11-07T01:40:57.4975578Z dpkg-source: error: cannot build with source format '3.0 (quilt)': non-native package version does not contain a revision
2026-11-07T01:40:57.4997336Z dpkg-buildpackage: error: dpkg-source -b . subprocess failed with exit status 25
2026-11-07T01:40:57.5031151Z debuild: fatal error at line 1185:
2026-11-07T01:40:57.5031661Z dpkg-buildpackage -us -uc -ui -S -d failed
2026-11-07T01:40:57.5074568Z ##[error]Process completed with exit code 29.
```

### Root cause and affected files

`debian/source/format` specifies `3.0 (quilt)`.

Both `tools/debian/make-deb` and `tools/debian/ppa-build-source` generate this version:

```sh
VERSION=0.1.${DATE}~${DISTRO}
```

That version has no Debian revision (`-1`, for example), which is required for this non-native source format. Both scripts also name the original source tarball using `${VERSION}`. Any repair must separate the upstream version from the full package version so the original archive retains the correct upstream name.

The workflow's artifact collection also depends on the current version suffix:

```sh
mkdir source && mv ../*~$(lsb_release -cs).* source
```

Adding `-1` after the distribution means this glob no longer matches the generated `.dsc`, `.debian.tar.xz`, `.changes`, and related output names. Correct package generation and artifact collection together.

### Recommended repair

Use an explicit upstream version and Debian revision, for example:

```sh
UPSTREAM_VERSION=0.1.${DATE}~${DISTRO}
VERSION=${UPSTREAM_VERSION}-1
```

Use the full `${VERSION}` for the changelog and `${UPSTREAM_VERSION}` for `darling_${UPSTREAM_VERSION}.orig.tar.xz`. Apply the same convention to the PPA source script, preferably using a shared version helper so the two paths cannot drift. Collect the actual generated source package files into the workflow artifact directory without the now-invalid distro suffix assumption.

A focused fixture should exercise real `dpkg-source -b` with the generated version/archive convention; it can prove source package correctness without rebuilding all of Darling. The Node 20 action deprecation notice is unrelated to the failed source package command. Preserve `3.0 (quilt)` rather than changing package semantics to conceal the invalid version.

## Original large artifact transport

No simpler authenticated byte-download route was verified in this audit. The existing GitHub connection's generic fetch endpoint rejects binary responses; `gh` is unauthenticated locally. A purpose-built original-archive download that preserves bytes and IDs is necessary for independent verification. Root is implementing a narrowly scoped authenticated workflow that exports exact original ZIP bytes in bounded parts. This audit did not alter or validate that transport implementation.
